''See also: [[Elder (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elders]] are immensely powerful, immortal beings that possess dominion over fundamental forces such as time, space, knowledge, memory, and the cycle of life and death. They are capable of instantly generating living flesh and can manipulate reality in ways that surpass human ability. While most [[Great Elders]] operate independently, pursuing distinct cosmic goals—such as the search for knowledge, absolute nothingness, or a balance between life and death—they generally do not interact with one another. They utilize the void for travel and communication between different worlds. In relation to humanity, [[Elders]] are viewed as existential threats that desire the collapse of civilization and the fragmentation of The Empire{{!}}the Empire. Historically, the Emperor maintained order by harnessing [[Elder power]] to rule as a figure comparable to a [[Great Elder]]. Currently, The Empire{{!}}the Empire employs various groups, such as the [[Blackwatch]] and Navigators, to study Elder biology, contain their influence, and utilize [[Elderspawn]] as guides across the [[Aion Sea]]. Some maritime vessels even attempt to bind or chain Elder creatures to assist in navigation. Despite their immense power, individual [[Elders]] can be bound through deals or marks, though they often harbor resentment toward human Authority{{!}}authority and maintain their own long-term ambitions.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elders]] are formidable entities possessing the strength required to capsize entire ships. They exhibit a unique biological ability to manifest as rapidly growing flesh upon walls, which serves to heal wounds. While they are a type of power contained within [[Jerri's Vessel]], they can be restrained through the use of [[invested chains]]. It is noted that certain sparks observed by Urzaia Woodsman{{!}}Urzaia do not actually belong to an Elder.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elders]] can manifest as flesh on walls that grows rapidly and heals wounds.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The sparks seen by Urzaia Woodsman{{!}}Urzaia are not Elder.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c7">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Elder is a type of power found in [[Jerri's Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
